purpose: Authored prose questions for the source-finding benchmark. Only the wording below is written by hand; the expected passage is the requirement named in 'requirement', resolved against the corpus at run time so a wrong ID fails loudly. The questions deliberately avoid the identifiers and the title wording of their requirement - that is the point of the family: lexical search has nothing to match on.
authored_by: Claude (not a tester assessment: these are search queries, not quality judgements)

questions.question: How often are the individual cell voltages read, and what happens to a single implausible reading among them?
How does the system notice that a measuring lead to a cell has come loose?
How is it checked that the high-voltage side is still properly separated from the car body?
What has to happen in which order before the main contactors may close?
How is a contactor that has stuck together and no longer opens detected?
How is the remaining charge of the battery worked out while the car is driving?
How much power may be drawn or fed back at this moment, and for how long?
How does the control unit notice that a high-voltage connector has been opened?
What does the battery do when the car has an accident?
What can wake the control unit again once it has gone to sleep?
Under which conditions is equalising the cells allowed to start, and when is it forbidden?
How is a discharge switch that no longer opens or no longer closes found?
What happens when the pack is too cold to be charged?
How much time do the occupants get to leave the car before it may burn, and how are they told?
How is the available power reduced step by step once a fault has been confirmed?
Which values are stored alongside a fault so the cause can be reconstructed later?
How does the charging current behave as the pack approaches a full state near the end of charging?
What is done when the plug on the car gets too hot while charging?
How is someone stopped from guessing the service access code over and over?
How regularly does the battery send its measured values onto the bus, and how much may that timing wander?
